chunks: Salama ibn Muhammad narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn Dawood narrated to us, saying: Ahmad ibn al-Hasan narrated to us, from Imran ibn al-Hajjaj, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Muhammad ibn Ishaq, from Usayd ibn Tha'laba, from Umm Hani', who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir: 'What is the meaning of the saying of Allah,

key_terms.الْخُنَّسِ: The one who recedes or conceals himself

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the Quranic verse 'By the stars that recede' according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Baqir interprets the 'receding stars' of Surah Al-Mutaffifin as a metaphor for the Hidden Imam's prolonged concealment, specifically pinpointing the year 260 AH as the end of the period where public knowledge of him ceases. The description of his sudden appearance 'like a burning meteor' emphasizes the dramatic transition from obscurity to manifest authority, offering a eschatological promise of joy to those who survive to witness the reappearance.
